source.title: New study casts doubt on how AI companies test the safety systems meant to keep their agents in check
source.text: The UK AI Security Institute is questioning whether simulated sabotage tests for AI monitors actually prove anything. In a new study, a former OpenAI monitor built on GPT-5.4 missed only 0.2 to 0.5 percent of harmful actions under standard attacks but nearly 23 percent when researchers used optimized methods. Simulated tests alone don't prove that monitors will hold up in live deployments, the study concludes. The article New study casts doubt on how AI companies test the safety systems meant to keep their agents in check appeared first on The Decoder .
